claim_scope: The Python JMT direct proof-object and canonical-wire boundaries snapshot actual byte buffers, rebuild exact owned proof values before encoding or verification, reject constructor-forged incoherent fields, and return false without mutation for malformed in-process proof objects.
failure_modes: a bytes subclass substitutes different key, value, hash, or proof bytes through its __bytes__ hook
a constructor-forged membership proof authenticates an absent key through hostile equality
a constructor-forged absence proof authenticates absence of a present key through hostile equality
an encoder serializes a forged proof that its own decoder rejects or interprets as different values
a malformed forged sibling escapes as an exception instead of a false verifier result

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges one minimized hostile byte or forged proof object, acts once through a public JMT root, encoder, decoder, or verifier boundary, and asserts the raw-buffer-derived root, exact typed rejection, or false verifier result.

reject_is_noop.reason: The proof decoders, encoders, and verifiers are pure. Malformed forged inputs produce a typed exception at construction/encoding or false at verification and cannot change the root, proof, or caller state.

mutations.description: copy byte subclasses with bytes(value), dispatching attacker-controlled __bytes__
trust dataclass identity and compare hostile proof fields before rebuilding exact owned bytes
use forged sibling fields directly and let malformed internals raise from the verifier
encode outer-class-matching forged proofs without transitively revalidating their fields

nonclaims: This packet closes the reproduced Python in-process hostile-object boundary failures; it is not a cryptographic proof of JMT soundness.
Canonical wire decoding already rejected ordinary malformed and duplicate-field JSON; this change adds raw-buffer and direct-object defenses.
No authenticated batch update, multiproof, durable version store, pruning, migration, RISC0 refinement, or atomic publication is implemented.
The JMT value and payload resource ceilings remain unspecified and unpromoted.
No runtime, release, settlement, migration, writer-rotation, or production authority is granted; production_authority remains NONE.
